catalog_custom_options_date_fields_order.summary: The order of day, month and year in custom date option inputs.
catalog_custom_options_date_fields_order.usage: Sets how date-type custom options are laid out on the storefront — for example day/month/year versus month/day/year.

catalog_custom_options_time_format.summary: Whether custom time options use 12- or 24-hour format.
catalog_custom_options_time_format.usage: Controls the clock format shown for date/time custom options on product pages.

catalog_custom_options_use_calendar.summary: Show a calendar picker for date custom options.
catalog_custom_options_use_calendar.usage: When Yes, date custom options use a calendar widget instead of plain dropdowns.

catalog_custom_options_year_range.summary: The range of years offered in date custom options.
catalog_custom_options_year_range.usage: Limits the selectable years for date custom options, entered as a four-digit from,to range. Leave blank for the default range.

catalog_downloadable_content_disposition.summary: Whether downloadable files download or open in the browser.
catalog_downloadable_content_disposition.usage: Sets the Content-Disposition for downloadable links — force a download, or open the file inline in the browser.

catalog_downloadable_disable_guest_check.summary: Require an account when the cart has downloadable items.
catalog_downloadable_disable_guest_check.usage: When Yes, orders containing downloadable products require a customer account (guest checkout is blocked), unless the product's links are shareable.

catalog_downloadable_downloads_number.summary: Default number of downloads allowed per purchased link.
catalog_downloadable_downloads_number.usage: The default download limit applied to new downloadable links. Leave blank or 0 for unlimited.

catalog_downloadable_links_target_new_wi.summary: Open downloadable links in a new browser window.
catalog_downloadable_links_target_new_wi.usage: When Yes, download links open in a new tab or window.

catalog_downloadable_links_title.summary: Default heading shown above a product's downloadable links.
catalog_downloadable_links_title.usage: The default title for the Links section on downloadable product pages (for example, "Links").

catalog_downloadable_order_item_status.summary: When a purchased download becomes available.
catalog_downloadable_order_item_status.usage: Whether access to downloads is granted once the order is Pending, or only after it is Invoiced (paid).

catalog_downloadable_samples_title.summary: Default heading shown above a product's sample files.
catalog_downloadable_samples_title.usage: The default title for the Samples section on downloadable product pages (for example, "Samples").

catalog_downloadable_shareable.summary: Allow downloadable links to be used without signing in.
catalog_downloadable_shareable.usage: When Yes, downloadable links are shareable and can be accessed without a customer account, which also permits guest checkout for them.

catalog_fields_masks_meta_description.summary: Template for auto-generating a product's meta description.
catalog_fields_masks_meta_description.usage: Pattern used to build the meta description when a product has none. Supports placeholders such as {{name}} and {{description}}.

catalog_fields_masks_meta_keyword.summary: Template for auto-generating a product's meta keywords.
catalog_fields_masks_meta_keyword.usage: Pattern used to build meta keywords when a product has none. Supports placeholders such as {{name}} and {{sku}}.

catalog_fields_masks_meta_title.summary: Template for auto-generating a product's meta title.
catalog_fields_masks_meta_title.usage: Pattern used to build the meta title when a product has none. Supports the {{name}} placeholder.

catalog_fields_masks_sku.summary: Template for auto-generating a product SKU.
catalog_fields_masks_sku.usage: Pattern used to build a SKU when none is entered. Supports the {{name}} placeholder.

catalog_frontend_default_sort_by.summary: The default product sort order on category pages.
catalog_frontend_default_sort_by.usage: Which sort shoppers see first on category listings, unless an individual category overrides it.

catalog_frontend_default_sort_by_order.summary: Direction of the default category sort.
catalog_frontend_default_sort_by_order.usage: Whether the default category sort runs ascending or descending.

catalog_frontend_flat_catalog_category.summary: Use the flat category index on the storefront.
catalog_frontend_flat_catalog_category.usage: When Yes, the storefront reads categories from the flat index — a legacy performance option. Flat catalog is deprecated and is usually left No.

catalog_frontend_flat_catalog_product.summary: Use the flat product index on the storefront.
catalog_frontend_flat_catalog_product.usage: When Yes, the storefront reads products from the flat index — a legacy performance option. Flat catalog is deprecated and is usually left No.

catalog_frontend_grid_per_page.summary: Default number of products per page in grid mode.
catalog_frontend_grid_per_page.usage: The pre-selected "per page" count for grid view. Must be one of the allowed values below.

catalog_frontend_grid_per_page_values.summary: The selectable per-page counts for grid mode.
catalog_frontend_grid_per_page_values.usage: Comma-separated list of "products per page" choices offered to shoppers in grid view.

catalog_frontend_list_allow_all.summary: Offer an "All" option in the per-page dropdown.
catalog_frontend_list_allow_all.usage: When Yes, shoppers can choose to show every product on one page. Use with care on large categories.

catalog_frontend_list_mode.summary: Which view modes (grid/list) category pages offer.
catalog_frontend_list_mode.usage: Sets whether category pages show a grid, a list, or both with one as the default.

catalog_frontend_list_per_page.summary: Default number of products per page in list mode.
catalog_frontend_list_per_page.usage: The pre-selected "per page" count for list view. Must be one of the allowed values below.

catalog_frontend_list_per_page_values.summary: The selectable per-page counts for list mode.
catalog_frontend_list_per_page_values.usage: Comma-separated list of "products per page" choices offered to shoppers in list view.

catalog_frontend_remember_pagination.summary: Remember each shopper's page-size and sort choices.
catalog_frontend_remember_pagination.usage: When Yes, pagination and sort selections persist for the shopper across pages. May affect SEO and increase the number of cached page variations.

catalog_frontend_show_swatch_tooltip.summary: Show a preview tooltip when hovering a swatch.
catalog_frontend_show_swatch_tooltip.usage: When Yes, hovering a colour or image swatch shows an enlarged preview tooltip.

catalog_frontend_show_swatches_in_produc.summary: Show configurable swatches on category listings.
catalog_frontend_show_swatches_in_produc.usage: When Yes, swatches appear on product tiles in category and search results, not only on the product page.

catalog_frontend_swatches_per_product.summary: Maximum swatches shown per product in listings.
catalog_frontend_swatches_per_product.usage: Caps how many swatches are displayed on a product tile in listings before the rest are truncated.

catalog_layered_navigation_display_categ.summary: Show the category filter in layered navigation.
catalog_layered_navigation_display_categ.usage: When Yes, a category filter appears in layered navigation on listing pages.

catalog_layered_navigation_display_produ.summary: Show the product count next to each filter option.
catalog_layered_navigation_display_produ.usage: When Yes, each layered-navigation option shows how many products match it.

catalog_layered_navigation_interval_divi.summary: Minimum products before a price range is subdivided.
catalog_layered_navigation_interval_divi.usage: Price intervals holding fewer products than this are not split further in layered navigation.

catalog_layered_navigation_one_price_int.summary: Collapse identical prices into a single interval.
catalog_layered_navigation_one_price_int.usage: When Yes, products that all share one price are grouped into a single price filter rather than a range.

catalog_layered_navigation_price_range_c.usage: Whether layered-navigation price ranges are built automatically (by equal spans or equal product counts) or from a fixed manual step.

catalog_layered_navigation_price_range_m.summary: Maximum number of price intervals shown.
catalog_layered_navigation_price_range_m.usage: Caps how many price ranges layered navigation displays (up to 100).

catalog_layered_navigation_price_range_s.summary: The fixed price step used for manual ranges.
catalog_layered_navigation_price_range_s.usage: The width of each price interval when the range calculation is set to Manual.

catalog_navigation_max_depth.summary: How many category levels appear in the top menu.
catalog_navigation_max_depth.usage: The maximum category depth rendered in the storefront top navigation. 0 means no limit.

catalog_placeholder_placeholder.summary: Fallback image shown when a product has no image.
catalog_placeholder_placeholder.usage: The default placeholder used wherever a product is missing its own image, set per image role (base, small, thumbnail, swatch).

catalog_price_scope.summary: Whether product prices are global or set per website.
catalog_price_scope.usage: Sets the scope of catalog prices. Global uses one price everywhere; Website allows a different price per website. Changing it can affect existing prices and must line up with your base-currency scope.

catalog_product_video_play_if_base.summary: Autoplay the base video on the product page.
catalog_product_video_play_if_base.usage: When Yes, the product's base video plays automatically when the page opens.

catalog_product_video_show_related.summary: Show related YouTube videos after playback.
catalog_product_video_show_related.usage: When Yes, YouTube may display related videos when a product video finishes.

catalog_product_video_video_auto_restart.summary: Loop product videos when they finish.
catalog_product_video_video_auto_restart.usage: When Yes, a product video restarts automatically after it ends.

catalog_product_video_youtube_api_key.summary: YouTube Data API key used to embed product videos.
catalog_product_video_youtube_api_key.usage: The API key required to load and play YouTube videos on product pages.

catalog_productalert_allow_price.summary: Let customers subscribe to price-drop alerts.
catalog_productalert_allow_price.usage: When Yes, a "notify me when the price drops" option appears on product pages.

catalog_productalert_allow_stock.summary: Let customers subscribe to back-in-stock alerts.
catalog_productalert_allow_stock.usage: When Yes, a "notify me when back in stock" option appears on out-of-stock products.

catalog_productalert_email_identity.summary: The store identity price/stock alert emails are sent from.
catalog_productalert_email_identity.usage: Which store email identity (sender) is used for product-alert emails.

catalog_productalert_email_price_templat.summary: The email template used for price-drop alerts.
catalog_productalert_email_price_templat.usage: The transactional template used when sending price-alert emails.

catalog_productalert_email_stock_templat.summary: The email template used for back-in-stock alerts.
catalog_productalert_email_stock_templat.usage: The transactional template used when sending stock-alert emails.

catalog_productalert_cron_error_email.summary: Address that receives product-alert cron error reports.
catalog_productalert_cron_error_email.usage: The email notified if the product-alert cron job fails.

catalog_productalert_cron_error_email_id.summary: The sender identity for cron error emails.
catalog_productalert_cron_error_email_id.usage: Which store email identity sends product-alert cron error notifications.

catalog_productalert_cron_error_email_te.summary: The template for product-alert cron error emails.
catalog_productalert_cron_error_email_te.usage: The transactional template used to report product-alert cron failures.

catalog_productalert_cron_frequency.summary: How often product-alert emails are sent.
catalog_productalert_cron_frequency.usage: The schedule on which the product-alert cron job runs and sends queued price and stock alerts.

catalog_productalert_cron_time.summary: Time of day the product-alert cron runs.
catalog_productalert_cron_time.usage: The clock time at which the product-alert job runs on its scheduled days.

catalog_recently_products_compared_count.summary: How many compared products to keep per shopper.
catalog_recently_products_compared_count.usage: The maximum number of items retained in a shopper's "recently compared" list.

catalog_recently_products_recently_compa.summary: How long recently-compared entries are kept (seconds).
catalog_recently_products_recently_compa.usage: Lifetime, in seconds, of a shopper's recently-compared product records.

catalog_recently_products_recently_viewe.summary: How long recently-viewed entries are kept (seconds).
catalog_recently_products_recently_viewe.usage: Lifetime, in seconds, of a shopper's recently-viewed product records.

catalog_recently_products_scope.summary: The scope recently viewed/compared lists are shared across.
catalog_recently_products_scope.usage: Whether a shopper's recently viewed and compared products are shared per website, per store, or per store view.

catalog_recently_products_synchronize_wi.usage: When Yes, these lists are saved on the server so they follow a signed-in customer across devices.

catalog_recently_products_viewed_count.summary: How many viewed products to keep per shopper.
catalog_recently_products_viewed_count.usage: The maximum number of items retained in a shopper's "recently viewed" list.

catalog_review_active.summary: Enable product reviews on the storefront.
catalog_review_active.usage: When Yes, customers can read and submit product reviews.

catalog_review_allow_guest.usage: When Yes, shoppers can post reviews without an account. When No, only signed-in customers can.

catalog_search_autocomplete_limit.summary: Maximum suggestions shown in search autocomplete.
catalog_search_autocomplete_limit.usage: Caps how many suggestions appear in the search-box dropdown as a shopper types.

catalog_search_engine.summary: The search engine powering catalog search.
catalog_search_engine.usage: Selects the backend used for product search and indexing. If left unset, the default engine is used.

catalog_search_enable_eav_indexer.summary: Use the product EAV indexer to speed up indexing.
catalog_search_enable_eav_indexer.usage: When Yes, the product EAV indexer is enabled to speed up indexation. Make sure your search engine is configured to support it.

catalog_search_max_count_cacheable_searc.summary: How many popular search terms are cached.
catalog_search_max_count_cacheable_searc.usage: The number of popular search terms kept in cache for faster responses.

catalog_search_max_query_length.summary: Maximum length of a search query.
catalog_search_max_query_length.usage: Queries longer than this are truncated. Must be compatible with the matching setting in your search engine.

catalog_search_min_query_length.summary: Minimum length of a search query.
catalog_search_min_query_length.usage: Queries shorter than this are ignored. Must be compatible with the matching setting in your search engine.

catalog_search_search_recommendations_co.summary: How many search recommendations to show.
catalog_search_search_recommendations_co.usage: The number of recommended terms displayed for a search.

catalog_search_search_recommendations_co.summary: Show result counts next to search recommendations.
catalog_search_search_recommendations_co.usage: When Yes, each recommendation shows how many results it would return.

catalog_search_search_recommendations_en.usage: When Yes, searches suggest related terms. May slow the site on large catalogs.

catalog_search_search_suggestion_count.summary: How many search suggestions to show.
catalog_search_search_suggestion_count.usage: The number of "did you mean" suggestions offered for a search.

catalog_search_search_suggestion_count_r.summary: Show result counts next to search suggestions.
catalog_search_search_suggestion_count_r.usage: When Yes, each suggestion shows how many results it would return.

catalog_search_search_suggestion_enabled.usage: When Yes, misspelled searches receive "did you mean" suggestions. May slow the site on large catalogs.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_enable_aut.summary: Require authentication to connect to Elasticsearch 8.
catalog_search_elasticsearch8_enable_aut.usage: When Yes, Magento sends the username and password below when connecting to Elasticsearch.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_index_pref.summary: Prefix for the Elasticsearch indexes Magento creates.
catalog_search_elasticsearch8_index_pref.usage: Namespaces this installation's indexes so several stores can share one Elasticsearch cluster without clashing.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_minimum_sh.summary: The minimum-should-match rule for Elasticsearch queries.
catalog_search_elasticsearch8_minimum_sh.usage: Controls how many query terms must match. Uses Elasticsearch's minimum_should_match syntax.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_password.usage: The password Magento uses when Elasticsearch authentication is enabled.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_server_hos.usage: The host Magento connects to for Elasticsearch.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_server_por.usage: The TCP port Magento uses to reach Elasticsearch.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_server_tim.summary: Connection timeout for Elasticsearch, in seconds.
catalog_search_elasticsearch8_server_tim.usage: How long Magento waits for Elasticsearch to respond before giving up.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_test_conne.usage: Runs a live check that Magento can reach Elasticsearch with the settings above.

catalog_search_elasticsearch8_username.usage: The username Magento uses when Elasticsearch authentication is enabled.

catalog_search_opensearch_enable_auth.summary: Require authentication to connect to OpenSearch.
catalog_search_opensearch_enable_auth.usage: When Yes, Magento sends the username and password below when connecting to OpenSearch.

catalog_search_opensearch_index_prefix.summary: Prefix for the OpenSearch indexes Magento creates.
catalog_search_opensearch_index_prefix.usage: Namespaces this installation's indexes so several stores can share one OpenSearch cluster without clashing.

catalog_search_opensearch_minimum_should.summary: The minimum-should-match rule for OpenSearch queries.
catalog_search_opensearch_minimum_should.usage: Controls how many query terms must match. Uses OpenSearch's minimum_should_match syntax.

catalog_search_opensearch_password.usage: The password Magento uses when OpenSearch authentication is enabled.

catalog_search_opensearch_server_hostnam.usage: The host Magento connects to for OpenSearch.

catalog_search_opensearch_server_port.usage: The TCP port Magento uses to reach OpenSearch.

catalog_search_opensearch_server_timeout.summary: Connection timeout for OpenSearch, in seconds.
catalog_search_opensearch_server_timeout.usage: How long Magento waits for OpenSearch to respond before giving up.

catalog_search_opensearch_test_connect_w.usage: Runs a live check that Magento can reach OpenSearch with the settings above.

catalog_search_opensearch_username.usage: The username Magento uses when OpenSearch authentication is enabled.

catalog_seo_category_canonical_tag.summary: Add a canonical link tag to category pages.
catalog_seo_category_canonical_tag.usage: When Yes, category pages emit a canonical URL to reduce duplicate-content issues in search engines.

catalog_seo_category_url_suffix.usage: The suffix added to category URL keys. Refresh the cache after changing it.

catalog_seo_generate_category_product_re.summary: Generate URL rewrites for products under categories.
catalog_seo_generate_category_product_re.usage: When Yes, products get category-path URLs. Warning: turning this off permanently removes existing category/product URL rewrites.

catalog_seo_product_canonical_tag.summary: Add a canonical link tag to product pages.
catalog_seo_product_canonical_tag.usage: When Yes, product pages emit a canonical URL to reduce duplicate-content issues in search engines.

catalog_seo_product_rewrite_context.summary: Scope used when generating product URL rewrites.
catalog_seo_product_rewrite_context.usage: Whether product URL rewrites are generated at the website or the store-view level when a product is edited.

catalog_seo_product_url_suffix.usage: The suffix added to product URL keys. Refresh the cache after changing it.

catalog_seo_product_url_transliteration.summary: Transliterate accented characters in product URLs.
catalog_seo_product_url_transliteration.usage: When Yes, non-ASCII characters in URL keys are converted to ASCII equivalents.

catalog_seo_product_use_categories.summary: Include the category path in product URLs.
catalog_seo_product_use_categories.usage: When Yes, product URLs include their category path (for example /category/product).

catalog_seo_save_rewrites_history.summary: Keep a redirect when a URL key changes.
catalog_seo_save_rewrites_history.usage: When Yes, changing a product or category URL key creates a permanent (301) redirect from the old URL.

catalog_seo_search_terms.summary: Make the storefront search-terms page available.
catalog_seo_search_terms.usage: When Enabled, the popular-search-terms page is accessible to shoppers and search-engine crawlers.

catalog_seo_title_separator.summary: Character separating the parts of page titles.
catalog_seo_title_separator.usage: The separator placed between segments of SEO page titles — for example a dash or a pipe.
